verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਨਾਦੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sree gur sabadh sun sravan kapaaT khule naadhai mil naadh anahadh liv laiee hai ||

en.bdb: Listening to the sermon of the True Guru, ignorance of a Guru-conscious disciple is removed. He is then absorbed in the amalgamation of the melodies of Guru's words and divine mystical tunes of the unstruck music, perpetually playing in the tenth door.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸਬਦ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਾਇਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਝਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਧਾਰ ਭਾਠੀ ਕੈ ਚੁਆਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gaavat sabadh ras rasanaa rasain kai nijhar apaar dhaar bhaaThee kai chuaaiee hai ||

en.bdb: Reciting the Lord's name that is the treasure-house of all the pleasures, a continuous flow of elixir takes place from the furnace-like tenth door.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: hiradhai nivaas gur sabadh nidhaan giaan dhaavat baraj unaman sudh paiee hai ||

en.bdb: Guru's words are the source of all knowledge. By its installation in the mind, a Guru-oriented person stops wandering in ten directions and acquire awareness of the mind that is God-oriented.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਅਵੇਸ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਹ ਧਾਰਿ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਦਿਬਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੨੮੩॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh aves paramaarath praveh dhaar dhib dheh dhib jot pragaT dhikhaiee hai ||283||

en.bdb: Becoming one with Guru's words, a Guru-oriented person achieves salvation. The divine light of the Lord then glows and radiates in him. (283)
